from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

control_path = Path('products/services/editorial-sqlite-controls/invoice-tag-totals.json')
entry = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/fulfillment/diagnose.py')
output = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/bespoke-inbound/invoice-quote-rehearsal/director-entrypoint-check.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
control = json.loads(control_path.read_text())
query = 'exists_counts_each_tagged_invoice_once'
expected = control['expected_cents'][query]
result = {'scope': 'Fictional offline SQLite control. No buyer, delivery or payment evidence.', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(control_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'entrypoint_sha256': hashlib.sha256(entry.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'cases': {}}
for label, cents in [('confirmed', expected), ('deliberate_mismatch', expected + 1)]:
    case = {'case_id': 'fictional-invoice-' + label, 'seed_sql': control['setup_sql'], 'query_sql': control['queries'][query], 'expected_last_rows': [[str(cents)]]}
    case_path = Path('case.json')
    report_path = Path('report.json')
    report_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    case_path.write_text(json.dumps(case, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', str(entry), str(case_path), str(report_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    observed = {'input': case, 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(case_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'stdout': run.stdout}
    if report_path.is_file():
        observed['report_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        observed['report'] = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
        observed['stdout_matches_report'] = run.stdout == report_path.read_text()
    result['cases'][label] = observed
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
